title: Frozen Model SLA Manifest: IO guarantees, parameter TTLs, and perf profile publication
creator: Maya Chen
description: Establish a machine-readable SLA/contract (the "IO SLA Manifest") for frozen/pinned model releases that defines the guaranteed input shapes, accepted prompt parameter ranges, stable output shape/semantic markers, and published performance profile artifacts. This ticket formalizes the contract, the CI gating rules, and the publishing procedure for perf snapshots used by Console and the Model Catalog.
acceptance_criteria: A JSON manifest format specification exists and is checked into runtime/specs/frozen_model_manifest.md in the repo
CI gating rule enforces: prompt shape schema, parameter whitelist/TTL, and output shape/semantic fingerprint delta thresholds for every pinned release PR
Perf profile publisher uploads per-release artifacts to the model catalog with reproducible names (model@release/perf-YYYYMMDD-HHMM) and exposes token-level latency/cost summaries
Regression harness contains 50 canonical prompts and produces a pass/fail report against baseline tolerances; failures open ENG tickets automatically
Onboarding doc for PMs and Solutions (Confluence) describing how to request a frozen release and the deprecation window for parameters
implementation_plan: Draft manifest schema: fields include input_shape, required_parameters, optional_parameters_with_deprecation_date, output_shape_schema, semantic_fingerprint, perf_profile_uri, compatibility_tier
Add a lightweight validator to runtime/tools/manifest_validator.py and wire it into runtime CI for pinned-release tags
Extend regression harness: add semantic fingerprint comparator that uses embedding-distance thresholds and named tolerance bands
Hook perf publisher to existing nightly benchmark job; add artifact naming convention and checksum metadata
Update Console model catalog UI to surface 'frozen manifest' metadata and perf snapshot selector (frontend work in a follow-up PM ticket)
risks_and_tradeoffs: Tight IO guarantees increase onboarding friction for model owners and may slow initial iterations; mitigation: provide a 'compatibility_tier=loose' mode for first 14 days
Semantic fingerprinting (embedding-based) may produce false positives for creative models; mitigation: use labeled canonical prompts and percentile-based thresholds
Publishing perf snapshots increases storage and retention cost; mitigation: keep rolling 30-day active snapshots and archive older ones compressed

Enforcing parameter TTLs requires catalog coordination and increases surface area for breaking changes; mitigation: include automatic deprecation warnings in responses when using soft-deprecated params
progress: 2025-10-02: Kickoff meeting with runtime, infra, and product. Agreed on manifest primary fields and CI integration points. Action: Liam to draft schema.
2025-10-06: Draft schema v0.1 created and reviewed in runtime spec PR #4281. Initial feedback from Research on semantic_fingerprint representation (prefer vector hash + seed prompts).
2025-10-09: Regression harness updated with 25 canonical prompts; still short of 50 target. Perf publisher prototype uploads artifacts to staging catalog bucket (s3://redwood-staging-model-catalog).
2025-10-12: Security review requested for artifact signing and KMS usage; SecOps suggested a signed manifest field and retention policy. Added to scope.
2025-10-14: Internal design review with Product. PM asked for a 'graceful degradation' FAQ entry and a developer CLI for manifest generation.
review_feedback: Product (Aisha Kapoor): Add clear rollback instructions and how Console will indicate a regression to customers.
Research (Diego Ramos): Use normalized embedding distances with per-model baselines rather than absolute thresholds; include example calculation in spec.
Security (Rina Patel): Manifests must be signed with the release key and the perf artifacts checksum recorded; update CI to sign artifacts before upload.
Design (Noah Blake): Surface minimal manifest metadata in the model card; keep full manifest behind an expandable panel to avoid clutter.
next_steps: Finalize manifest schema v0.2 addressing review feedback by 2025-10-18
Land runtime/tools/manifest_validator.py (PR #4302) and add CI gate for pinned-release labels
Complete canonical prompt set to 50 and run baseline comparisons across dedicated-qa cluster
Create a follow-up PM ticket to coordinate Console UI changes and customer-facing docs
Add artifact signing hook to nightly perf job and update Confluence retention policy
